text:
IncidentBot: P1 incident created — elevated 5xx + increased tail latency in us-west-1 affecting Hosted API + several Dedicated pools. Paging oncall: @Aisha (sre-oncall). Link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1827504321 :rotating_light:

Aisha (sre-oncall): I see a spike starting ~1827504200, 5xx from edge -> gateway -> model workers. Canary traffic shows 40% 5xx for seq>2048. Latency p95 up from 120ms to ~1.6s.

Ben (eng-runtime): logs from gateway:
```
2026-07-11T14:05:03Z gateway error auth-introspect failed status=502 provider=okta body="upstream response: 502 Bad Gateway"
2026-07-11T14:05:04Z modelpool/worker id=dedicated-usw1-42 request_id=abc123 kvcache-miss
```
Most 5xx are 502/503 coming out of token-introspect path and some ELB 504s.

Tom R.: Okta status? any cloud control-plane events?

ObservabilityOps: Datadog reports partial ingest outage for us-west-1, traces/metrics delayed ~2-3m — https://status.datadoghq.com/incidents/xxx. Also seeing spikes in agent-side backoff.

DatadogBot: Incident link: https://status.datadoghq.com/ -- degraded logs/metrics in us-west-1 (confirmed by vendor).

Kavita (prod-ops): Customer impact: Hosted public API error rate >15% for requests routed to us-west-1, Dedicated pools pinned to us-west-1 seeing throughput drop; a handful of premium customers on Dedicated reported increased errors. We're preparing customer-facing note.

Aisha (sre-oncall): Quick triage plan:
1) Verify if token introspection (auth provider) is the common denom.
2) Fail open/skip introspection for internal service-to-service tokens (temp) where policy allows.
3) Route new hostnames to eu-west-2 as fallback for hosted endpoints.
4) Disable non-essential observability sampling to reduce dataplane load.

Can we get a quick auth vendor check from Tom/Ben?

Tom R.: Okta status shows elevated 5xx on their token introspect endpoint in us-west-1: https://status.okta.com/incident/abc. They confirm degraded auth in that region.

Ben (eng-runtime): Reproduced locally: our gateway retries on 401->introspect failures, but misconfigured backoff caused spike. Patch ready to flip to linear backoff + max 2 retries. Pushing canary now. Command:
```
kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/gateway AUTH_INTROSPECT_RETRIES=2 AUTH_BACKOFF_MS=200
```
Will monitor.

Aisha (sre-oncall): Also enable region-fallback routing for hosted-api: route-control runbook invoked to shift 30% traffic from us-west-1 -> eu-west-2 for non-PII routes. @María can you handle the routing change?

María S.: On it. Executing route-control: ```route-control promote --from=us-west-1 --to=eu-west-2 --percent=30 --filter=public``` ETA 2m.

IncidentBot: action taken by María S.: routing promotion 30% complete.

Kavita (prod-ops): Notifying top affected Dedicated customers: drafting message. Holding until we confirm mitigation.

Ben (eng-runtime): Canary patch applied to gateway nodes in us-west-1. Initial telemetry shows 5xx from introspect down from 40% -> 18% on canary. Backoff change reduced retries and queueing.

Aisha (sre-oncall): Good. Next steps: if vendor not restored in 15-30m, escalate to full regional failover for hosted traffic and initiate Dedicated pool rebalancing to other regions for customers allowing cross-region. Ben, prepare scripts to drain and reprovision Dedicated workers in eu-west-2.

María S.: Routing now at 60% warm; will continue to 90% if telemetry looks good.

ObservabilityOps: Note — Datadog ingest delays mean our dashboards will lag. Use sampling logs + direct kube logs for immediate verification.

Ben (eng-runtime): Rebalancing script (dry-run):
```
./dedicated-rebalance --from-region=us-west-1 --to-region=eu-west-2 --limit=20 --dry-run
```
I can run actual after oncall gives go.

Aisha (sre-oncall): I'll hand over primary incident lead to María in 15m. María, you'll own mitigation + customer comms. Ben remains engineering lead for runtime fixes. Kavita owns customer-notes.

(14:28) María S.: Taking lead. Summarizing for comms: degraded auth in us-west-1 (Okta) + observability ingest delays (Datadog) causing gateway retries and elevated latency/5xx. Mitigations: gateway backoff change, routing fallback to eu-west-2, optional Dedicated rebalancing.

(14:35) Kavita (prod-ops): Draft to customers:
> We're investigating increased errors and latency for requests routed to us-west-1. We're routing traffic to alternative region and applying mitigations. No data loss. We'll update in 30 minutes.

Request review from María/Ben.

(14:46) Ben (eng-runtime): Okta reports partial recovery in us-west-1 — error rates decreasing on their side. We're keeping routing fallback in place for 30m to drain queues. Gateway metrics show errors down to 4-6% now.

(14:53) Aisha (sre-oncall): Oncall handoff: I'm stepping off at 15:00. María remains lead. Please ping if regression.

(15:05) IncidentBot: Incident status -> monitoring. Root cause: third-party auth provider (Okta) degraded in us-west-1; compounded by observability ingest delays (Datadog) that obscured early signals and exacerbated retry cascades.

María S.: Closing actions: follow-up postmortem, consider token-introspect caching for 60s to reduce dependency, add circuit-breaker in gateway to fail-open for service tokens, and add playbook for cross-region promotion of Dedicated pools. Kavita will send customer postmortem.

Kavita (prod-ops): Will send initial customer update now and add customers to private incident channel for Direct Customers.

Aisha (sre-oncall): Leaving oncall. Good handover.

ObservabilityOps: Creating ticket to instrument independent healthcheck for third-party auth and to add Datadog alternative fallback (Honeycomb) in runbook.

IncidentBot: incident 1827504321 -> status: resolved (mitigations applied, vendor recovery observed). Postmortem TKT-ID: INC-2026-0711-01.

María S.: Thanks all. We'll follow up with postmortem and CL recommendations. :white_check_mark:
